name: Swain
gaps: Parcels are OperationalLayers Tax Parcels (CAMA + polygons) (https://maps.swaincountync.gov/server/rest/services/OperationalLayers/MapServer/4). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Pass 2 enrichment is from card pass2 (tax ok, sale partial). Pass 2 counted 142 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 sale: No sale fields on OperationalLayers/4. AGOL Swain_County_Parcels/0 Deed_Date non-null = 12,316 of 13,551 (live 2026-09-28); price only on ITSPublicSW AppraisalCard PDF.
Swain acreage is a string. The filter uses CAST AS FLOAT and LegalLandType='AC'. PIN is empty, so the parcel id is PARCEL_ID.

PIN is null everywhere, so use PARCEL_ID (the card md/yaml already say so; the JSON layer has no fieldMap). The acreage field is a string and needs CAST. Numeric alternate: AGOL Swain_County_Parcels/0 Acreage (13,551; 5–150 = 2906).
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
